item.title: Version 1.0
item.description:
Observio is now 1.0 — on the Mac, iPhone and iPad. This release brings a new program guide, pause live TV, seven languages, and playback libraries built entirely under open-source licenses.

Program guide

  • The list guide is now the default: channels on the left, the full schedule of the selected channel on the right. The timeline grid is one click away.
  • The guide follows your group. It opens on the group you're browsing, and a group picker lets you look at any other.
  • The timeline grid now scrolls with the mouse or trackpad anywhere, including over the channel column.

Watching

  • Pause live TV and pick up where you left off (up to 10 minutes).
  • Watch your Mac recordings on iPhone and iPad, and schedule recordings on the Mac from the phone's guide.
  • Open With sends a channel to any video player installed on your Mac.
  • Subtitle search (OpenSubtitles, with your own free API key) and Trakt scrobbling.
  • Fixed channels that could play without sound in the MPV engine.

Your home and your channels

  • Customize the home screen: reorder or hide rows and add discovery rows (trending, top rated, by language or year) built only from titles you can already play.
  • Multiple favorites lists.
  • Providers whose refresh failed are marked on their card, including sign-in problems, instead of failing silently.

Everywhere

  • Seven languages: English, Portuguese, Spanish, German, French, Italian and Dutch.
  • Better VoiceOver support and clearer wording throughout ("Guide" instead of "EPG", "Movies & Series" instead of "VOD").

Under the hood

  • The media libraries (mpv and FFmpeg) and the bundled ffmpeg tool are now built entirely under the LGPL, from source, with Apple's own TLS. Settings › About › Open Source Licenses links the exact source.
  • Version numbers now start at 1.0 on every platform. This update installs over earlier versions as usual.

item.title: Version 1.0.1
item.description:
Fixes for the new program guide and Immersive mode.

  • The guide no longer shows "No channels in this group" when you open it before your provider has finished loading. It now shows the channels as soon as they arrive.
  • The list guide opens on the first channel that has a schedule, instead of a separator row like "#### Portugal ####".
  • Switching to the timeline grid now scrolls straight to the current time instead of midnight.
  • ⌘E opens the guide from the Home screen too, on the provider you used last.
  • The window can be made smaller: the minimum size is now 800 × 600.
  • Immersive mode: the controls and the Recent Channels row stay on screen while the pointer rests on them, so the highlight on the card you're pointing at no longer disappears.

item.title: Version 1.0.2
item.description:
A polish release: menus that all work, a better-behaved Immersive mode, and a lighter app.

Menus and shortcuts

  • Add Provider (⌘N), Add Provider from URL (⌘I), Export Backup and Import Backup now work — they did nothing before. So does Picture in Picture.
  • The Playback, Audio and Channel menus work while a player window is in front and while paused, and in Immersive mode.
  • ⌘M minimizes again (Mute is ⌃⌘M) and ⌘C copies text again (Copy Channel Name is ⌥⌘C). One Edit and one View menu instead of two.
  • The Keyboard Shortcuts window (⌘/) now matches the real keys.

Immersive mode

  • Esc, Esc leaves Immersive mode again, and ⌘⇧I works to leave it.
  • Typing or scrolling in Settings no longer controls the player behind it.
  • The controls stay up while the pointer is on them or a menu is open.
  • Pressing Return after typing a channel number no longer restarts the stream.

Player window

  • The arrow keys skip by your Skip Step setting, and a spinner shows when a stream stalls.
  • ⌘ shortcuts reach the menu bar instead of being taken by the player.

Lighter

  • About 30% less memory with a large program guide (repeated guide text is stored once).
  • Fewer background wake-ups: idle timers stop when nothing needs them.

Polish

  • Loading screens instead of “No channels” or “No movies found” while a provider loads.
  • Times read naturally (“2h 50m left”), with proper plurals, in all seven languages.
  • Plain wording throughout: no more “EPG”, “VOD” or “AV+”.
  • Lists respond to the first click; better VoiceOver labels.
  • Help is up to date.

item.title: Version 1.0.3
item.description:
Observio now keeps your place: close the player or leave full screen and you're back where you were browsing.

Keeps your place

  • Playing a channel no longer changes the group you're browsing. Playing from Favorites, Recent, search, the guide or Movies & Series used to switch the channel list to another group, or back to All Channels.
  • Choosing a group in the player's channel panel no longer changes the main window behind it.
  • The channel list no longer jumps to the new channel every time you change channel in the player.
  • Switching between Immersive and Classic keeps the section and view you were on.
  • Immersive mode remembers its sidebar section, search and grid position after you play something. Favorites shows all your favorites, not just those in the current group.

Immersive mode

  • Parental controls now apply in Immersive mode. Locked channels ask for your PIN, and the PIN window appears over full screen.
  • Playing from the guide or a channel's menu stays in Immersive instead of opening a separate player window.

Privacy

  • Spotlight no longer shows hidden or parentally locked channels, and forgets channels from providers you've removed.

item.title: Version 1.0.4
item.description:
A new look, and movie and series details that come from your own provider.

New icon

  • Observio has a new icon and wave logo, in the Dock and inside the app.

Movies and series

  • Details from your provider first. Plot, cast, director, genres and trailers now come from your provider when it has them, with no setup.
  • Connect your own free TMDB key to fill any gaps: Settings › Integrations › TMDB, paste the key and press Test & Save. Both v3 keys and v4 read tokens work, and the key is kept in your Keychain.
  • Observio no longer ships a TMDB key of its own. Without your key, posters and details come from your provider only.
  • "Share setup" now brings your TMDB key along to your other devices.

item.title: Version 1.0.5
item.description:
TV Mode arrives, the TV Guide is rebuilt, and the whole app looks and feels like one.

TV Mode

  • TV Mode replaces Immersive. A full-screen, lean-back Observio for the big screen: the TV Guide, Live TV, Home, Movies & Series, My List, Search, Recordings and Settings, all driven by the keyboard, the mouse or the iPhone remote. View › TV Mode (⌘⇧T; ⌘⇧I still works). If you used Immersive, you now open in TV Mode.
  • The same interface as Observio on Android TV: a channel list that walks back through the days, one calm info band with your settings one click away, and Quick Controls for picture, sound and subtitles.
  • Choose what each key does in Settings › Keyboard & Remote.

TV Guide

  • Faster and clearer. The guide is redrawn in one pass, so scrolling stays smooth even with thousands of channels. Titles stay readable at the left edge, one line marks now, and the row you're on opens up with the time and a description.
  • The grid is the default view again. Your choice of agenda or grid is remembered.
  • "Program Guide" is now called TV Guide everywhere.

Channels

  • One number per channel, everywhere. A channel keeps the same number in every group, in the guide, in TV Mode and when you type it.
  • Provider dividers such as "#### Portugal ####" show as section headers and are skipped when you change channel.
  • Hovering a channel or a poster keeps it highlighted while the pointer rests on it.
  • Arrow to a channel in the list to see what's on next and later.

Player

  • A progress line under the program shows how far in you are and how many minutes are left.
  • The channel number and a red LIVE badge next to the channel name; stream details in clean capital badges.
  • The channel panel (P) shows numbers and progress, switches groups with ‹ ›, and its guide lists several days with replay days marked. Pick a program to Replay, Watch or be reminded.
  • Lighter on your Mac: the panels and bars no longer blur the video behind them.

Also

  • The Playback Rate setting now applies to movies, episodes and catch-up (live TV always plays at normal speed).
  • observio:// links from your iPhone open on the Mac, and always ask first.
  • Casting only serves your own playlist to your TV.
  • TV Mode and the new screens are translated into Portuguese, Spanish, German, French, Italian and Dutch.

item.title: Version 1.0.6
item.description:
Your devices stay in step, series get their artwork without any setup, and covers load faster.

Local Network Sync

  • Pair your Mac with your iPhone, iPad and Android devices with a code (Settings › Backup & Restore). Favorites, watch progress, watchlist, hidden channels and groups, custom lists and your playback preferences then stay in step over your Wi-Fi, directly between your devices and encrypted. Nothing goes through a server.

Movies & Series

  • Series posters and details without a TMDB key: when your provider has no artwork for a series, Observio fills in its poster, plot, genres, rating and cast from TVmaze. Your provider's own details always come first.
  • Covers load faster: what's on screen loads first, each cover appears as soon as it's ready, and the work happens in the background so the app stays smooth with large libraries.
  • Details looked up on TMDB are kept for at most six months, as TMDB's terms ask.

Player

  • One bar on live TV: the programme from the guide. When you pause or skip back, the bar shows where you are and a red LIVE button takes you back.
  • Fixes for casting and for channels that start mid-picture.

Also

  • Channels without a logo show their initials on their own colour in the guide.
  • Adult content stays out of Home and suggestions unless you turn it on, and follows what your provider marks as adult.
  • Profiles with a PIN keep it more securely, and ask for it before they can be edited or deleted.
  • Settings › Licences lists the full texts of the open-source libraries Observio uses.

item.title: Version 1.0.7
item.description:
Plex servers connect more reliably, and the fullscreen player gets a Close button.

Plex

  • Adding a Plex account finds a working address: Observio tries every address your server offers at once (same network, then direct over the internet, then Plex Relay) and keeps the first one that really serves your library.
  • Saved Plex accounts follow the server when its address changes: a library refresh asks Plex for the current address and switches to it.
  • Fixed films from some Plex servers that never started playing.

Player

  • Close button in fullscreen: top left, where the window's close button sits. It stops playback and takes you back to the app (same as ⌘W).

item.title: Version 1.0.8
item.description:
Plex servers that are only reachable through Plex Relay now play.

Plex

  • Films and series play over Plex Relay: when your server can only be reached through Plex's relay, Observio plays the server's converted stream (lower quality, made for the relay) instead of the original file. If playing the original file fails on any Plex server, it switches to the converted stream by itself.
  • When a server moves, playback follows: before a Plex title starts, Observio checks the saved address and, if the server moved, finds its new one and switches to it. A server that can't be reached says so within seconds instead of trying for minutes.
  • "Sign in to Plex again": when Plex no longer accepts an account's sign-in, the account says so in the sidebar and one click signs you in again, keeping the account.
  • A title that never started no longer resets your resume point on Plex, Emby or Jellyfin.

item.title: Version 1.0.9
item.description:
Playing a series straight away now works.

Movies & Series

  • Play on a series works even before its episodes have loaded: Observio shows "Loading episodes…" and then starts the episode you're in the middle of, or the next one you haven't watched. This fixes series from Plex (and some from Emby, Jellyfin and providers) that failed to play when Play was pressed right away.

item.title: Version 1.0.10
item.description:
Steadier playback, recording that needs only one connection, and a loading screen instead of an empty window.

Playback

  • Fixes a crash on Mac that could happen when the audio output changed (AirPods, a display with speakers) while a channel was stopping or changing.
  • Channels from providers that check the player now play on the built-in engine too: it sends your User-Agent and the channel's own headers.
  • Channel headers with commas (browser User-Agents) are no longer broken up, and a new User-Agent in Settings applies straight away.
  • Skipping in movies and series is faster, and pressing skip several times in a row adds up.

Recording

  • Recording saves the stream you're watching, so it needs no extra connection from your provider (most allow only one). It stops when you change channel or close the player, and "Auto-stop after" applies.
  • Want recordings that keep going in the background? Turn on Settings › Recording › Record over a second connection, only if your provider allows two or more connections at once.
  • If the stream reconnects during a recording, it continues in a new part file instead of starting over.

Guide & startup

  • A loading screen shows while your providers and channels load, instead of an empty window.
  • Large guides refresh reliably: the same guide is no longer downloaded several times at once.
  • The guide database and the playlist backup use much less disk space.

item.title: Version 1.0.11
item.description:
Live TV that recovers by itself, clearer errors with a way forward, and a calmer look.

Playback

  • Live channels recover by themselves: when a stream drops, Observio fetches a fresh link, retries as soon as your network is back, and keeps trying for about three minutes before it shows an error.
  • Clearer errors: a playback problem now says what it likely is (the provider refused the channel, the stream isn't responding, the format isn't supported) and what to try.
  • Try Another Engine (Playback menu, TV Mode's quick controls and the error card) replays a channel on a different engine, keeping your place in films and series.
  • Live streams that stall recover instead of freezing on a still picture.

Channels & guide

  • What's on now shows straight away for Xtream channels, even before the full guide has loaded, and big guides use much less memory.
  • Hidden channels can be brought back: Settings › Hidden Channels now lists every hidden channel, with Unhide and Unhide All.
  • Catch-up is offered only within each channel's archive, so older programmes no longer offer a replay that fails.

Look & feel

  • One slim loading bar everywhere, instead of different spinners and logos.
  • Channel cards no longer flash white when you point at them.
  • Provider icons and colours match on every screen.

item.description:
Lists that keep their channels, a smoother loading bar, and a remote that also works with Android TV.

Channels

  • Custom lists keep their channels: a list used to lose its channels after a provider refresh (it still showed the count). Lists now follow the channel itself, and on the Mac a list in the sidebar opens its channels again.
  • Favorites switch at once when you click the star, even on big providers.

Look & feel

  • A smoother loading bar that glides instead of flashing, and doesn't appear at all for quick loads.

Remote

  • The iPhone remote can now also control Observio on Android TV, on the same network.

item.title: Version 1.0.12
item.description:
Lists that keep their channels, a smoother loading bar, and a remote that also works with Android TV.

Channels

  • Custom lists keep their channels: a list used to lose its channels after a provider refresh (it still showed the count). Lists now follow the channel itself, and on the Mac a list in the sidebar opens its channels again.
  • Favorites switch at once when you click the star, even on big providers.

Look & feel

  • A smoother loading bar that glides instead of flashing, and doesn't appear at all for quick loads.

Remote

  • The iPhone remote can now also control Observio on Android TV, on the same network.

item.title: Version 1.0.13
item.description:
A fix for Macs on macOS 13 Ventura.

Fixes

  • Observio opens again on macOS 13: on Ventura, Observio could close right after launch once you had scheduled or made a recording. It now opens normally, and your recordings are kept.

item.title: Version 1.0.14
item.description:
New

  • One row per channel: when your provider lists a channel in several qualities (FHD, HD, SD, backups…), the channel lists, the guide and search show it once, in FHD. A small stacked mark shows how many versions it has. Right-click a channel (or use the player's channel panel) › Version to pick another, from the best down: FHD, FHD · HEVC, backups, HD, SD. Observio remembers your pick. Settings › Content turns it off, puts HD, 4K or SD first, or leaves backup streams out.
  • Automatic fallback: if the version you're watching stops working, Observio moves to the next-best version of the same channel on its own and tells you which.
  • Channel previews (off by default): the last picture of a channel on its card.

Fixes

  • Logos load more reliably: a logo that failed is tried again on its own, and channels without a logo in the playlist use the guide's.

New

item.title: Version 1.0.17
item.description:
Fixed

  • Channel changes on one-connection subscriptions: changing channel or version no longer stops with an error, switches version on its own or waits for a reconnect while the provider still counts the previous channel. Observio tries again quietly until the provider lets go, usually within a second or two.

item.title: Version 1.0.18
item.description:
Improved

  • Movies & Series stay light: opening Movies or Series no longer starts fetching posters and details for your whole catalogue in the background. Posters load for what's on screen; Settings › Data Usage › Download All Artwork fetches everything when you choose to.
  • Subtitle files from Emby and Jellyfin: subtitles kept as separate files next to a film on your server now appear in the subtitle list.

Fixed

  • Poster links from your provider that fail to load are looked up again from the provider or TMDB.
  • Audio delay set for one film no longer carries over to the next.

item.title: Version 1.0.24
item.description:
New

  • TV Mode quick channel list: hold ↑ or ↓ while you watch for a compact list of the channels: number, what's on and minutes left. Return watches the highlighted channel.
  • TV Mode → key: → shows the programme description; hold → for the channel's other versions.

Changed

  • In TV Mode's Standard and Custom remote layouts, holding ↑ and ↓ no longer opens History and Search, and → no longer goes to the last channel. History is in the player's chip row, Search is ⌘F and the last channel is ⌫.
